manifesto.linePre: We don't just build your systems.

services.heading: One connected system. Not four bills from four providers.
services.intro: Website, ERP, apps, email, hosting — most companies buy these from four different people and spend years paying for the gaps between them. We deliver the whole chain as one system, and keep running it after launch.

odoo.title: One system to run the whole business.
odoo.body: Odoo 18 — CRM, sales, stock, purchasing, accounting, HR, POS — configured to how you actually work, with custom modules where standard software stops. ERPNext when it fits better.

web.title: Sites and stores built for one company — because they were.
web.body: Custom Next.js and React storefronts and showcase sites, plus WordPress + WooCommerce. Multilingual FR / AR / EN. Wired into the ERP so stock and orders stay in sync.

about.heading: We work on the whole system, not one slice of it.
about.intro: Most companies don't buy one system. They buy four — a website from a freelancer, an ERP from another provider, email from a third, hosting from wherever the domain landed — and then spend years paying for the gaps between them. Coshift is a technical agency in Algeria that closes that gap: we build the whole chain and run it on our own infrastructure, as one connected system.

scope.title: The whole chain, not one slice.
scope.body: Website, ERP, apps, email, servers — we cover the whole system, so there's no seam left for you to own. Large integrators price this out of reach; freelancers only cover a slice. We sit in the gap, deliberately.

ownership.title: We run what we build.
ownership.body: Our own dedicated infrastructure, our own monitoring, our own backups. The project doesn't end at handover — we keep operating and improving it.

engineering.title: We write code, not just configure.
engineering.body: When standard software isn't enough, we build the module — loyalty logic, anti-fraud, integrations. That's the difference between an integrator and an engineer. We work in French, Arabic and English.

location.heading: Where we are.
location.body: Based in Algeria, serving Algerian SMEs and industrial companies — the owners and general managers who've outgrown spreadsheets and WhatsApp but can't justify a large integrator.

odoo.heading: One system. The whole business.
odoo.intro: We design, build, and operate Odoo 18 ERPs — CRM, sales, stock, purchasing, accounting, HR and POS — for companies done duct-taping spreadsheets and tools that don't talk to each other. We write custom modules where standard Odoo won't do, and we keep running the system after launch.

deliverables.heading: What you get
items: Discovery and workflow mapping — a working demo to log into, not a slide deck
Module selection, configuration, and custom development
Data migration from spreadsheets and legacy systems (clients, suppliers, employees, products)
Integration with what you already run — biometric attendance, e-commerce, mobile apps
User training and documentation in French, English, or Arabic
Hosting, backups and monitoring on our own infrastructure — or yours
Ongoing support after go-live — we run what we build

items.a: Usually Odoo — it's where most of our delivered work lives. ERPNext is a real option when it fits your case better, and we'll compare the two honestly rather than pushing one. (We're an independent studio, not a reseller.)
Both. We recommend based on your modules and scale. Enterprise pays for itself fast above a certain headcount; Community is right for many lean operations. We say which on day one.

items.q: Can you migrate us from another system?
items.a: Yes — from spreadsheets, legacy ERPs, and home-grown systems. Full data migration of clients, suppliers, employees and products is routine. The data work is the unglamorous part of the job; we own it.
We run it on our own dedicated infrastructure with backups and monitoring included — or on yours if you prefer. Either way, the project doesn't end at handover; we keep operating and improving it.

web.heading: Bespoke web. Not templates with paint.
web.intro: Custom storefronts, showcase sites, internal tools and customer portals — engineered like software, designed like editorial. Multilingual FR / AR / EN from day one, and wired into your ERP so stock, orders and customers stay in sync.

deliverables.heading: What you get
items: Custom Next.js / React build, or WordPress + WooCommerce where it fits
Brand-aligned design system, not a Figma kit graveyard
Multilingual content — French, Arabic, English — from day one
Integration with your ERP, payments and delivery — no double data entry
Server-side ad-conversion tracking that recovers sales the browser pixel loses
Hosting, deployment and monitoring on our own infrastructure

items.q: Do you do design and engineering, or just one?
items.a: Both, in the same room. We don't accept hand-offs we didn't shape; we don't ship designs we can't build.

items.q: Will the site we get look like this one?
items.a: No. Your site looks like your company. This one looks like ours.

items.q: Can you work with our existing brand?
items.a: Yes. We've taken brand systems from polished guideline PDFs to functional component libraries dozens of times.
A 90-day stabilisation is standard. Retainers from there are optional and scoped to actual needs.
